canonical_statement: Produce a connected simple 3-regular graph on fewer than 272 labelled vertices whose girth is at least 13. Acceptance improves the pinned public upper bound n(3,13)<=272 to the candidate order; it does not prove the exact cage number, and record status must be refreshed independently.
success_criterion: amf.cage3g13.exact.v1 checks the canonical edge set, degree three at every vertex, connectivity, and absence of every cycle shorter than 13, then accepts. A current table audit is required before a record claim.
partial_progress_criterion: Retain improvements inside a frozen voltage/Cayley family, exact exclusions of meaningful construction subclasses, and search trajectories with fewer short cycles.
stop_conditions: The maintained cage table moves below 272 before or during the run.
The candidate is only isomorphic to a known graph or lacks provenance needed for submission.
The separately approved experiment budget is exhausted.
